rows.name: Harvey LAB-AA v1.1
rows.focus: Artificial Analysis' implementation of Harvey's Legal Agent Benchmark (LAB), testing AI agents on real-world legal work from Harvey's dataset of 120 private tasks spanning 24 legal practice areas. v1.1, built in collaboration with Harvey, checks every deliverable against the task's source documents for hallucinations, so work that passes every rubric criterion but contains a material hallucination receives no credit. A panel of three judges grades each deliverable criterion-by-criterion.

rows.name: AA-PersonalityBench
rows.focus: Measures how models communicate rather than whether they are correct: 30 judged personality traits rolled up into 8 indexes, plus 21 measured communication characteristics.
rows.metrics: quality, uncertainty, effort, breakdown, votes, other
rows.metrics_detail:
Quality [page]: index percentiles (1-100) — 8 personality indexes percentile-ranked across models; underlying Elo z-scores · https://artificialanalysis.ai/evaluations/aa-personalitybench
Uncertainty [page]: 95% confidence interval — whiskers on leaderboards · https://artificialanalysis.ai/evaluations/aa-personalitybench
Effort [page]: model name suffix (e.g. (max), (xhigh)) — effort labels in names; page does not state the rule explicitly · https://artificialanalysis.ai/evaluations/aa-personalit
rows.notes: No single overall leaderboard: results are 8 personality indexes (Expressiveness, Organization, Informativeness, Transparency, Warmth, Conviction, Imagination, Slop) plus 30 trait leaderboards; not a capability score.
rows.difficulty_detail: Cannot be levelled: No single score and not a capability measure: 8 personality indexes (percentile-ranked Elo z-scores) plus 30 trait Elo leaderboards.
